card.title: A Delicious Mystery
card.instruction: Treat every missing fact, contradiction, and suspicious detail as delightful proof that the situation is becoming more interesting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The budget page is missing from our club minutes. Someone's made accounts night interesting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer took it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. A suspect with homework. Shall we ring her?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's here. She says she never took it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A contradiction in person! Bring her a chair beside mine; I'm staying for the whole meeting.

cardFidelity.evidence: Missing fact and contradiction are delightful proof of growing interest, not generic optimism or competence at solving crime.

responseLogic.evidence: A1 missing page prompts B2 explanation; A3 suggests ringing the supposed taker; B4 brings denial into the room; A5 requests proximity and stays.

relationship.evidence: B supplies actual explanation then corrects it with present testimony.

heightening.evidence: B4 denial in person causes A5 invitation beside A and commitment to the entire meeting.

specificity.evidence: Club member welcomes missing budget page as relief from boring accounts meeting.

brevityWit.evidence: B4 denial in person causes A5 invitation beside A and commitment to the entire meeting.

card.title: A Delicious Mystery
card.instruction: Treat every missing fact, contradiction, and suspicious detail as delightful proof that the situation is becoming more interesting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You ordered our anniversary cake, but the baker says we cancelled. What an intriguing start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have the receipt. It says collected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancelled and collected! Let's ask who collected it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says you did. He has your signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now I'm involved! Bring the receipt; this is much more personal than dinner.

cardFidelity.evidence: A welcomes contradiction and suspicious implication as interesting, rather than trying to prove innocence or merely celebrate bad news.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 collected receipt contradicts cancellation; A3 asks collector; B4 names A with signature; A5 embraces personal implication and takes receipt.

relationship.evidence: B pursues practical cake information and supplies uncomfortable evidence.

heightening.evidence: B4 naming A changes an external puzzle into personal involvement, explicitly used by A5.

specificity.evidence: Anniversary cake is apparently cancelled despite order; A enjoys the developing mystery.

brevityWit.evidence: B4 naming A changes an external puzzle into personal involvement, explicitly used by A5.

G1.evidence: Anniversary cake is apparently cancelled despite order; A enjoys the developing mystery.

G2.evidence: Receipt and baker claims conflict explicitly. A does not resolve whose signature it is; delight does not require that answer.

comparisons.S141: Mechanism: each missing or contradictory fact increases delighted investigative interest. Confusable with generic cheerfulness; dialogue must welcome the puzzle specifically. Alternatives: bored committee participant recruits a live contradictory witness; anniversary partner embraces becoming the suspect.
